mapping.draft_py:
# FDN Elfsworn Giant: "Reach. Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, create a 1/1 green Elf
# Warrior creature token."
# ZNR Scute Swarm's landfall trigger; KHM Skemfar Elderhall's Elf Warrior TokenSpec, count 1.
trigger = TriggeredAbility(
    event=ZoneChangeEvent(
        from_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
        to_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
        subject=FAnd(
            children=(
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Land'),
            ),
        ),
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=A(Verb.CREATE_TOKEN, {
        'count': QConst(value=1),
        'tokens': TokenSpec(
            name='Elf Warrior',
            type_line='Creature — Elf Warrior',
            types=('Creature',),
            subtypes=('Elf', 'Warrior'),
            power=QConst(value=1),
            toughness=QConst(value=1),
            keywords=(),
            abilities=(),
            colors=('G',),
        ),
    }),
)
abilities = [trigger, *compiled]

clauses.clause: Reach (This creature can block creatures with flying.)
Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, create a 1/1 green Elf Warrior creature token.

mapping.notes: Scute Swarm's landfall trigger with Skemfar Elderhall's Elf Warrior TokenSpec, count 1. Reach compiled. packs in tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/: elfsworn_giant_only_your_lands, elfsworn_giant_two_lands_at_once_two_elves.
